coverage.note: Core KB v1 keeps 20 pivot drivers while all 101 lookup entries still map into the core network.

drivers.name: Taux directeurs des banques centrales
drivers.description: Niveau du taux directeur implicite pour la zone ou l'economie de reference.

drivers.name: Liquidite globale
drivers.description: Conditions globales de bilan des banques centrales et abondance de liquidite en dollars.

drivers.name: Liquidite du systeme bancaire
drivers.description: Disponibilite de collateraux et de depots dans le systeme bancaire.

drivers.name: Conditions de credit
drivers.description: Tightening ou easing de l'offre de credit bancaire et de marche.

drivers.name: Spreads de credit IG/HY
drivers.description: Prime de risque demandee sur la dette corporate investment grade et high yield.

drivers.name: Spreads souverains
drivers.description: Prime de risque souveraine versus Bund ou Treasury de reference.

drivers.name: Inflation headline
drivers.description: Variation annuelle du CPI/IPC, incluant energie et alimentation.

drivers.name: Inflation core
drivers.description: Inflation sous-jacente hors composantes volatiles, plus utile pour la reaction des banques centrales.

drivers.name: Anticipations d'inflation
drivers.description: Breakevens 5y5y et surveys de menages/entreprises sur l'inflation future.

drivers.name: Croissance du PIB
drivers.description: Impulsion de croissance reelle, proxifiee par PIB et nowcasts.

drivers.name: Emploi et chomage
drivers.description: Solidite du marche du travail via NFP, taux de chomage et job openings.

drivers.name: Investissement prive
drivers.description: FBCF privee et depenses capex cycliques.

drivers.name: Consommation des menages
drivers.description: Dynamique de demande finale des menages et resilience du revenu reel.

drivers.name: Force du dollar
drivers.description: Direction du dollar global, captee via DXY et flux refuges.

drivers.name: Prix du petrole
drivers.description: Prix spot et futures du Brent/WTI comme choc energetique global.

drivers.name: Prix des metaux industriels
drivers.description: Prix du cuivre, aluminium et panier de metaux cycliques.

drivers.name: Sentiment de marche
drivers.description: Appetit pour le risque / aversion au risque, via VIX, credit et breadth.

drivers.name: Risque geopolitique
drivers.description: Niveau de tension geopolitique a portee macro, militaire ou diplomatique.

drivers.name: Dette publique
drivers.description: Charge et trajectoire de dette souveraine rapportee au PIB.

drivers.name: Balance commerciale
drivers.description: Solde commercial et deterioration / amelioration des flux exterieurs.

causal_arcs.empirical_justification: Rate hikes tighten bank lending standards with a short lag.
Balance sheet tightening and higher policy rates drain global dollar liquidity.
Higher discount rates lift refinancing stress for corporate issuers.
Rate differentials support USD through carry and safe-rate demand.
Tighter policy slows activity with a several-quarter lag.
Disinflation works with a lag via demand destruction and financing costs.
Capex is rate-sensitive through hurdle rates and credit availability.
QE-style liquidity compresses sovereign term premia and spreads.
Abundant reserves and funding conditions ease bank credit creation.
Liquidity support improves cross-asset risk appetite.
Dollar liquidity expansion tends to soften the broad USD.
Banks with better liquidity buffers lend more readily.
Funding stress relief narrows corporate spread compensation.
Easier bank lending transmits directly into capex.
Consumer credit availability lifts durable goods demand.
Broad easing in credit conditions supports aggregate demand.
Looser financing conditions compress IG/HY spreads.
Wider spreads precede weaker investment and activity.
Credit stress quickly deteriorates risk sentiment.
Sovereign stress bleeds into domestic bank balance sheets and lending.
Higher sovereign funding costs worsen debt-service dynamics.
Repeated upside CPI prints re-anchor medium-term expectations higher.
Central banks react faster when headline inflation breaches comfort zones.
Real income compression weighs on household demand.
Inflation surprises can support USD via hawkish repricing.
Persistent core inflation is the most reliable trigger for policy tightening.
Sticky core services inflation shapes medium-term inflation expectations.
Breakeven drift higher tightens reaction functions.
Higher inflation expectations raise nominal term premia.
Stronger real activity reduces unemployment with a lag.
Growth improves income confidence and spending capacity.
Output growth raises capacity utilisation and capex demand.
Domestic-demand booms often widen import-driven trade deficits.
Rising unemployment weakens household confidence and spending.
Capex feeds directly into GDP through domestic demand and productivity.
Demand resilience sustains services inflation.
A stronger dollar dampens imported inflation.
Dollar strength reduces export competitiveness and widens trade deficits.
Commodity prices often soften when USD funding tightens.
Oil shocks pass rapidly into CPI through fuel and transport.
Energy taxation on consumers and firms slows growth.
Energy-importing economies see trade balances deteriorate when oil rises.
Input-cost pressure from metals can leak into core goods inflation.
Conflict near energy routes causes immediate crude risk premia.
Geopolitical escalation drives fast risk-off positioning.
Safe-haven flows lift the USD during geopolitical stress.
Sanctions and route disruptions impair external trade flows.
Improving sentiment narrows corporate risk premia.
Debt sustainability concerns widen sovereign spreads once debt ratios become elevated.
Persistent external surpluses support currency strength over time.

historical_episodes.label: Volcker shock tightening
calibration_lessons: Policy shock can dominate recession fears in the first phase.
Cross-asset reaction is strongest when inflation credibility is broken.
historical_episodes.notes: Policy shock can dominate recession fears in the first phase. | Cross-asset reaction is strongest when inflation credibility is broken.

historical_episodes.label: ECB rate hike into sovereign stress
calibration_lessons: Late-cycle hikes amplify sovereign and bank fragility.
EUR support is short-lived when credit transmission breaks.
historical_episodes.notes: Late-cycle hikes amplify sovereign and bank fragility. | EUR support is short-lived when credit transmission breaks.

historical_episodes.label: Fed QE1 expansion
calibration_lessons: Balance-sheet policy compresses sovereign and credit premia quickly.
USD weakness and gold strength are common first-order effects.
historical_episodes.notes: Balance-sheet policy compresses sovereign and credit premia quickly. | USD weakness and gold strength are common first-order effects.

historical_episodes.label: Taper Tantrum signal
calibration_lessons: Unexpected liquidity withdrawal shocks EM FX before growth data move.
Communication surprise matters more than the first mechanical flow reduction.
historical_episodes.notes: Unexpected liquidity withdrawal shocks EM FX before growth data move. | Communication surprise matters more than the first mechanical flow reduction.

historical_episodes.label: Fed liftoff inflation cycle
calibration_lessons: Rate hikes transmit fastest through duration and USD.
Credit and growth damage builds with a lag, not on day one.
historical_episodes.notes: Rate hikes transmit fastest through duration and USD. | Credit and growth damage builds with a lag, not on day one.

historical_episodes.label: US CPI upside shock
calibration_lessons: Inflation surprises can reroute the entire rates path in a single session.
Growth equities underperform before credit does.
historical_episodes.notes: Inflation surprises can reroute the entire rates path in a single session. | Growth equities underperform before credit does.

historical_episodes.label: Pandemic PMI collapse
calibration_lessons: PMI contractions are powerful early warnings for capex and trade weakness.
Market pricing moves ahead of GDP releases.
historical_episodes.notes: PMI contractions are powerful early warnings for capex and trade weakness. | Market pricing moves ahead of GDP releases.

historical_episodes.label: US payrolls collapse
calibration_lessons: Labor shocks hit consumption immediately even when policy support follows.
Bond rally is strongest when payroll weakness coincides with falling oil.
historical_episodes.notes: Labor shocks hit consumption immediately even when policy support follows. | Bond rally is strongest when payroll weakness coincides with falling oil.

historical_episodes.label: Iraq invades Kuwait
calibration_lessons: Oil and gold react immediately to military escalation near supply routes.
Safe-haven dollar demand can coexist with weaker global growth expectations.
historical_episodes.notes: Oil and gold react immediately to military escalation near supply routes. | Safe-haven dollar demand can coexist with weaker global growth expectations.

historical_episodes.label: Russia invades Ukraine
calibration_lessons: Europe transmits geopolitical energy shocks faster than the US.
Gas, FX and sovereign spread channels matter alongside crude.
historical_episodes.notes: Europe transmits geopolitical energy shocks faster than the US. | Gas, FX and sovereign spread channels matter alongside crude.

historical_episodes.label: US restores Iran oil sanctions
calibration_lessons: Sanctions shocks move trade balances and oil before they move GDP.
USD and sovereign spreads are key spillover channels.
historical_episodes.notes: Sanctions shocks move trade balances and oil before they move GDP. | USD and sovereign spreads are key spillover channels.

historical_episodes.label: Arab oil embargo
calibration_lessons: Supply shocks generate persistent headline inflation and growth drag.
Energy equities hedge the first-round inflation impulse better than broad equities.
historical_episodes.notes: Supply shocks generate persistent headline inflation and growth drag. | Energy equities hedge the first-round inflation impulse better than broad equities.

historical_episodes.label: OPEC+ production cut
calibration_lessons: Quota cuts reprice energy inflation quickly even without immediate physical scarcity.
Market positioning changes the second-round rates move.
historical_episodes.notes: Quota cuts reprice energy inflation quickly even without immediate physical scarcity. | Market positioning changes the second-round rates move.

historical_episodes.label: Nord Stream halt and EU gas panic
calibration_lessons: Regional gas shocks can overwhelm local macro despite limited direct US impact.
Utilities and sovereign curves diverge from US assets in Europe-specific crises.
historical_episodes.notes: Regional gas shocks can overwhelm local macro despite limited direct US impact. | Utilities and sovereign curves diverge from US assets in Europe-specific crises.

historical_episodes.label: US-China tariff round
calibration_lessons: Trade policy shocks hit confidence and capex before official trade data roll over.
EM FX and industrial metals are efficient fast indicators.
historical_episodes.notes: Trade policy shocks hit confidence and capex before official trade data roll over. | EM FX and industrial metals are efficient fast indicators.

historical_episodes.label: US-China phase one truce
calibration_lessons: Trade relief improves cyclical beta more than long duration assets.
FX relief is stronger in EM than in EUR crosses.
historical_episodes.notes: Trade relief improves cyclical beta more than long duration assets. | FX relief is stronger in EM than in EUR crosses.

historical_episodes.label: US debt ceiling and S&P downgrade
calibration_lessons: Political fiscal brinkmanship widens sovereign premia and damages sentiment.
USD safe-haven behaviour can offset domestic fiscal stress in the short run.
historical_episodes.notes: Political fiscal brinkmanship widens sovereign premia and damages sentiment. | USD safe-haven behaviour can offset domestic fiscal stress in the short run.

historical_episodes.label: American Rescue Plan
calibration_lessons: Large fiscal stimulus lifts growth, inflation and debt simultaneously.
Banks and value equities outperform when nominal growth rises.
historical_episodes.notes: Large fiscal stimulus lifts growth, inflation and debt simultaneously. | Banks and value equities outperform when nominal growth rises.

historical_episodes.label: Lehman bankruptcy
calibration_lessons: Bank failures propagate instantly via liquidity, credit and confidence.
Credit spreads and bank equities are the fastest stress barometers.
historical_episodes.notes: Bank failures propagate instantly via liquidity, credit and confidence. | Credit spreads and bank equities are the fastest stress barometers.

historical_episodes.label: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
calibration_lessons: Duration losses can morph into liquidity crises even without immediate credit losses.
Front-end rates can reverse sharply when financial stability replaces inflation as the policy focus.
historical_episodes.notes: Duration losses can morph into liquidity crises even without immediate credit losses. | Front-end rates can reverse sharply when financial stability replaces inflation as the policy focus.

historical_episodes.label: Ever Given blocks Suez
calibration_lessons: Shipping bottlenecks feed inflation faster than they hit GDP.
Commodity curves react sooner than broad equity indices.
historical_episodes.notes: Shipping bottlenecks feed inflation faster than they hit GDP. | Commodity curves react sooner than broad equity indices.

historical_episodes.label: China lockdown supply shock
calibration_lessons: Factory shutdowns propagate through inventories, shipping and final goods inflation.
Growth-sensitive commodities underperform after the initial scarcity spike.
historical_episodes.notes: Factory shutdowns propagate through inventories, shipping and final goods inflation. | Growth-sensitive commodities underperform after the initial scarcity spike.

historical_episodes.label: European drought disrupts rivers and crops
calibration_lessons: Climate shocks hit agriculture, logistics and power costs simultaneously.
Inflation linkers and utilities are more resilient than cyclical equities.
historical_episodes.notes: Climate shocks hit agriculture, logistics and power costs simultaneously. | Inflation linkers and utilities are more resilient than cyclical equities.

historical_episodes.label: US chip export ban on China
calibration_lessons: Strategic technology controls behave like a blend of trade and geopolitical shocks.
Semiconductor restrictions weaken EM equities before they hit top-line trade data.
historical_episodes.notes: Strategic technology controls behave like a blend of trade and geopolitical shocks. | Semiconductor restrictions weaken EM equities before they hit top-line trade data.
